attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Maine state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per ME tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maine Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi 0.07 mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Maine tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Maine military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Extended to Space Force, USPHS, and NOAA in 2026. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per 36 MRS § 5122 (2025).

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Maine military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "Maine Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.me_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.me_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.me_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.me_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.me_military_retirement_exclusion result.me_sbp_exclusion add /result.me_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.me_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.me_adjusted_agi xdef
"Maine military retirement exclusion: $" result.me_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.me_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Maine SBP exclusion: $" result.me_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Maine total military exclusion: $" result.me_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
